metadata.description: Maps 4-digit SIC codes to Thes1s 8-digit taxonomy codes. Covers all SIC codes in sicClassification.js SIC_MAP (4-digit) and SIC_MAJOR_GROUP_MAP (2-digit).
metadata.notes: Four-digit covers all unique SIC codes from SIC_MAP. Two-digit covers all from SIC_MAJOR_GROUP_MAP. Duplicate SIC keys in source (6159, 4953) resolved to single entries.

3672.notes: PCB manufacturing is EMS, not semiconductors

7377.notes: Rental/leasing is a services business, not hardware

5734.notes: Retail stores mapped to Retail - Specialty

2080.notes: Diversified beverages defaulted to non-alcoholic; reclassify per company

5141.notes: Food wholesale mapped to grocery as closest defensive retail

3021.notes: Athletic footwear maps to Athletic & Lifestyle (NKE, ONON)

3589.notes: SIC 3589 is Services Industry Machinery NEC, not consumer appliances

6199.notes: SIC 6199 often covers financial data/exchange companies

6321.notes: Health insurance mapped to Healthcare per Thes1s taxonomy

6324.notes: Medical service plans are healthcare, not general insurance

6399.notes: SIC diversified insurance mapped to Specialty; reclassify per company

6162.notes: Mortgage finance is a lending activity

4522.notes: Non-scheduled air transport is typically charter/cargo

7389.notes: SIC 7389 is broad Services NEC; mapped to Staffing as most common usage

2813.notes: Industrial gases (APD, LIN) are specialty chemicals

3011.notes: Tires are auto parts despite SIC rubber classification

3080.notes: Plastics products manufacturing mapped to Specialty Chemicals

15.notes: Building construction general contractors; may include homebuilders

28.notes: Chemicals and allied products; note SICs 2833-2836 are pharma

32.notes: Stone, clay, glass, and concrete products

35.notes: Industrial and commercial machinery and computer equipment

37.notes: Transportation equipment; includes autos but A&D is more common fallback

41.notes: Local/suburban transit and interurban passenger transportation

43.notes: US Postal Service (rare for SEC filers)

57.notes: Home furniture, furnishings, and equipment stores

62.notes: Security and commodity brokers, dealers, exchanges

63.notes: Insurance carriers; reclassify by type per company

73.notes: Business services; includes software (7372) and IT services

91.notes: Executive, legislative, general government (not typical for stocks)

95.notes: Administration of environmental quality and housing
